an4.71:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni c' assa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.71:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti bahussuto hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti.
an4.71:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni c' assa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyāti. 72.
